tweaks.name: Performance Power Plan
tweaks.description: Creates a separate Endless Performance plan from Windows Balanced and activates it. Apply individual power setting tweaks to copy their Windows High Performance values into this plan. Built-in plans are left untouched. Power use and heat can increase; results vary by device. Restore Default Power Plan returns to the plan that was active before activation.

tweaks.name: Windows Game Mode
tweaks.description: Enables Windows Game Mode for this user. Windows can prioritize game processes and reduce some background activity. It does not guarantee an FPS increase.

tweaks.name: Disable Game DVR capture
tweaks.description: Turns off Windows background game recording for this user. Xbox capture features will be unavailable until restored.

tweaks.name: Disable app capture
tweaks.description: Disables Windows app capture for this user. Game clips and screen recording may stop working.

tweaks.name: Use Windows fullscreen behavior
tweaks.description: Selects the Windows GameDVR fullscreen behavior value. Some older games may respond differently.

tweaks.name: Show file extensions
tweaks.description: Shows known file extensions in File Explorer. Makes file types easier to identify.

tweaks.name: Show hidden files
tweaks.description: Shows files marked hidden in File Explorer. Hidden files are not necessarily safe to edit.

tweaks.name: Show Explorer status bar
tweaks.description: Displays item count and selection details in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Open Explorer to This PC
tweaks.description: Makes File Explorer open to This PC instead of Home.

tweaks.name: Run Explorer windows separately
tweaks.description: Asks File Explorer to use a separate process for folder windows. May use more memory.

tweaks.name: Hide Task View button
tweaks.description: Hides the Task View button from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Hide taskbar Widgets
tweaks.description: Hides the Widgets button from the taskbar. Widgets remain available in Windows settings.

tweaks.name: Align taskbar left
tweaks.description: Moves taskbar icons to the left where supported by this Windows version.

tweaks.name: Hide legacy Cortana button
tweaks.description: Hides the legacy Cortana taskbar button on Windows versions that still provide it.

tweaks.name: Stop recent document tracking
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from tracking recent documents for Start and jump lists. Recent lists will be empty.

tweaks.name: Show all navigation folders
tweaks.description: Shows system locations in the File Explorer navigation pane.

tweaks.name: Expand to current folder
tweaks.description: Automatically expands the navigation tree to the folder currently open.

tweaks.name: Hide sync provider notices
tweaks.description: Hides cloud provider promotional notifications in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Stop Start menu app tracking
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from tracking frequently used apps for Start recommendations.

tweaks.name: Hide Start recommendations
tweaks.description: Disables Start menu recommendations on Windows builds that support this setting.

tweaks.name: Hide taskbar Chat button
tweaks.description: Hides the legacy Chat button on Windows versions that include it.

tweaks.name: Enable Explorer item check boxes
tweaks.description: Enables check boxes for selecting files in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Show compressed files distinctly
tweaks.description: Uses a different color for compressed and encrypted files in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Show full path in Explorer title
tweaks.description: Requests the full folder path in File Explorer window titles where supported.

tweaks.name: Show empty removable drives
tweaks.description: Shows empty removable drives in This PC.

tweaks.name: Prefer best visual performance
tweaks.description: Selects Windows visual-effects best-performance mode. It reduces decorative effects and can make Windows less visually rich.

tweaks.name: Disable taskbar animations
tweaks.description: Turns off taskbar animation effects where supported.

tweaks.name: Disable transparency effects
tweaks.description: Turns off Windows transparency effects for this user.

tweaks.name: Use dark app theme
tweaks.description: Sets supported Windows apps to dark appearance. This is a visual preference, not an FPS tweak.

tweaks.name: Use dark Windows theme
tweaks.description: Sets supported Windows surfaces to dark appearance.

tweaks.name: Never combine taskbar buttons
tweaks.description: Keeps separate taskbar buttons where the Windows version supports this mode.

tweaks.name: Never combine multi-monitor buttons
tweaks.description: Keeps separate taskbar buttons on secondary monitors where supported.

tweaks.name: Show taskbar on every monitor
tweaks.description: Enables taskbar display on all monitors where supported.

tweaks.name: Show seconds in taskbar clock
tweaks.description: Requests seconds in the taskbar clock on Windows builds supporting this setting.

tweaks.name: Use compact taskbar icons
tweaks.description: Requests compact taskbar icons on Windows versions that support this setting.

tweaks.name: Disable background app activity
tweaks.description: Requests that packaged apps do not run in the background for this user. Some notification and sync features may be delayed.

tweaks.name: Disable web search in Start
tweaks.description: Disables web results in Windows Search on builds that honor this user setting. Local search remains available.

tweaks.name: Disable location in Search
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows Search from using location for this user where the setting is supported.

tweaks.name: Remove Explorer startup delay
tweaks.description: Sets Explorer's per-user startup serialization delay to zero. This may not change startup time on newer builds.

tweaks.name: Hide Windows Search taskbar control
tweaks.description: Hides the taskbar search control on Windows builds that honor this current-user setting. Windows Search remains available from Start.

tweaks.name: Use compact taskbar search
tweaks.description: Sets the Windows taskbar search mode to hidden where this setting is supported.

tweaks.name: Hide Copilot taskbar button
tweaks.description: Hides the Copilot taskbar button on Windows 11 builds that provide it. This does not uninstall Copilot.

tweaks.name: Hide Xbox Game Bar startup panel
tweaks.description: Stops the Xbox Game Bar welcome/startup panel from appearing for this user where supported.

tweaks.name: Dismiss Xbox Game Bar startup tip
tweaks.description: Sets the Game Bar startup tip index to a completed value for this user. It only affects the Game Bar tip experience.

tweaks.name: Disable window animations
tweaks.description: Disables the classic per-user minimize and maximize animation. This changes Windows behavior and may make the desktop feel less polished; it does not promise higher game FPS.

tweaks.name: Disable notification banners
tweaks.description: Turns off Windows toast notifications for this user. You may miss app alerts while gaming; restore this setting to bring them back.

The change takes effect only while that plan is active; power use, heat, and device behavior can vary. No FPS or latency gain is guaranteed.

tweaks.name: Short keyboard repeat delay
tweaks.description: Uses repeat-delay level 0. Holding a key starts repeating sooner; accidental repeats may be easier. Does not change raw game input. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Fast keyboard repeat
tweaks.description: Sets repeat-rate level 31 for text input. Holding keys repeats faster in apps that honor the setting. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Standard pointer speed
tweaks.description: Sets Windows pointer speed to 10 of 20. Changes desktop sensitivity; games using raw input can ignore it. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove pointer trails
tweaks.description: Removes cursor trails. Cursor tracking may be harder for users who rely on trails. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Stop pointer jumping to dialog buttons
tweaks.description: Keeps the cursor at its current position when a dialog opens. You must move to its default button yourself. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Disable Ctrl pointer locator
tweaks.description: Removes the locator rings shown when Ctrl is pressed. This changes pointer visibility assistance. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Use hold-to-drag mouse behavior
tweaks.description: Disables ClickLock. Dragging will require holding the mouse button; review before applying if you rely on ClickLock. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Keep pointer visible while typing
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from hiding the pointer during typing. It can overlap text until you move it away. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Precise hover width
tweaks.description: Sets the hover detection width to 4 pixels in apps using the Windows default. Small movements can cancel hover activation. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Precise hover height
tweaks.description: Sets the hover detection height to 4 pixels in apps using the Windows default. Small vertical movements can cancel hover activation. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Shorter hover wait
tweaks.description: Requests hover notifications after 200 ms in apps using HOVER_DEFAULT. Tooltips may appear sooner and be more distracting. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Three-line vertical scrolling
tweaks.description: Sets the vertical wheel increment to 3 lines. Apps can use their own scrolling behavior. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Three-character horizontal scrolling
tweaks.description: Sets a horizontal wheel increment of 3 characters. Requires a wheel or input device that supplies horizontal scrolling. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Scroll the focused application
tweaks.description: Routes the mouse wheel to the focused app instead of an inactive window under the cursor. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Expose keyboard navigation controls
tweaks.description: Asks supporting apps to show keyboard-oriented controls that they would otherwise hide. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Always show menu shortcut letters
tweaks.description: Keeps keyboard access-letter underlines visible in supporting menus. Adds small visual markings. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Shorter submenu opening delay
tweaks.description: Sets the submenu delay to 150 ms. Cascading menus can open more easily while moving the pointer. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove menu opening animation
tweaks.description: Requests immediate opening of classic menus. Modern apps may draw their own menus. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove dropdown animation
tweaks.description: Turns off classic combo-box opening animation. Changes the appearance of supported dropdowns. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove list-box smooth scrolling
tweaks.description: Uses direct scrolling in supporting list boxes. Scrolling can appear less fluid. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Use solid classic title bars
tweaks.description: Disables classic title-bar gradients. This may have no visible effect on modern app-rendered title bars. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove classic hover highlighting
tweaks.description: Stops hot-tracking highlights on supporting classic UI elements. Pointer location feedback is reduced. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove menu selection fade
tweaks.description: Removes the lingering fade of a selected menu item after the menu closes. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove tooltip opening animation
tweaks.description: Opens supporting tooltips without an animation. Does not change their hover delay. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove cursor shadow
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows cursor shadow. Custom app cursors may be unaffected. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Remove classic window drop shadows
tweaks.description: Turns off shadows for window classes that honor the classic drop-shadow preference. Modern compositor effects may differ. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Use flat classic menus
tweaks.description: Requests flat native menu styling. Apps using their own menu renderer may ignore it. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Reduce client-area animations
tweaks.description: Asks supporting applications to stop content-area animations. Motion and transition cues may be reduced. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Show window outline while dragging
tweaks.description: Requests an outline while moving a window instead of its full contents. Some applications manage dragging themselves. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Keep focus until a window is clicked
tweaks.description: Disables activation by hovering over a window. Click the target window to switch focus. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Drag maximized windows to restore
tweaks.description: Allows dragging a maximized title bar to restore the window. Requires Windows window arrangement to be enabled. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Enable window edge docking
tweaks.description: Allows moving windows to screen docking targets. Requires Windows window arrangement to be enabled. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Enable vertical snap sizing
tweaks.description: Allows vertical maximization by sizing a window to a screen edge. Requires Windows window arrangement to be enabled. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Wider mouse docking target
tweaks.description: Sets the mouse docking threshold to 10 pixels. Edge docking can trigger earlier. Requires window arrangement. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Deliberate mouse undocking
tweaks.description: Requires a 30-pixel inward mouse drag for the undock threshold. Requires window arrangement. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Standard mouse vertical-restore threshold
tweaks.description: Sets the mouse side-move threshold to 50 pixels for vertically maximized windows. Requires window arrangement. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Standard pen docking target
tweaks.description: Uses a 30-pixel pen docking threshold. Applies to pen window drags; requires window arrangement. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Standard pen undocking distance
tweaks.description: Uses a 30-pixel inward pen-drag threshold for undocking. Requires window arrangement. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Standard pen vertical-restore threshold
tweaks.description: Uses a 50-pixel pen side-move threshold for vertically maximized windows. Requires window arrangement. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Wider keyboard focus indicator
tweaks.description: Sets the left and right focus-border width to 2 pixels in supporting controls. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Taller keyboard focus indicator
tweaks.description: Sets the top and bottom focus-border height to 2 pixels in supporting controls. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: More visible text cursor
tweaks.description: Sets the text caret width to 2 pixels. Some editors use their own caret rendering. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Longer notification reading time
tweaks.description: Requests 10 seconds for supporting notification popups. Notifications can remain on screen longer. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Wrap desktop icon labels
tweaks.description: Allows icon captions to span lines. Requires more room for long labels. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Roomier icon columns
tweaks.description: Requests 96-pixel icon cells horizontally. DPI scaling can affect displayed spacing; fewer icons may fit in a row. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Roomier icon rows
tweaks.description: Requests 96-pixel icon cells vertically. DPI scaling can affect displayed spacing; fewer icons may fit in a column. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Enable text edge smoothing
tweaks.description: Enables Windows font antialiasing. Text appearance changes; apps with custom rendering may be unaffected. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Use ClearType text smoothing
tweaks.description: Selects ClearType for supporting text. Requires font smoothing enabled; appearance depends on the display. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: Standard ClearType contrast
tweaks.description: Sets ClearType contrast to 1400. Requires ClearType selected; choose based on readability, not FPS. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.

tweaks.name: RGB text subpixel orientation
tweaks.description: Selects RGB subpixel ordering. Only appropriate for RGB displays; BGR or rotated screens can look worse. Requires ClearType selected. Windows preference; no FPS or device-latency gain is claimed.
